QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_19

question.text: Which of the following is NOT listed in the chapter as a 'material change' to the PPM that triggers a compulsory exit option for dissenting investors?

answer.text: Change in sponsor / manager (not including internal restructuring within the group).
Change in control of sponsor / manager.
Change in fee structure or hurdle rate which may adversely affect investors.
A non-material change in the email address or contact number of the AIF or its Manager or Sponsor.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 8, material changes triggering a compulsory exit option include (1) change in sponsor/manager (excluding internal group restructuring), (2) change in control of sponsor/manager, and (3) change in fee structure or hurdle rate adversely affecting investors. The chapter explicitly classifies email/address/contact-number updates as NON-MATERIAL — no exit option arises. The Trap: Three of the options are taken verbatim from the material-change list; only the contact-detail change is labeled non-material in the chapter. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers the same material-change taxonomy. Chapter 15 of XIX-D syllabus cross-references these exit rights in greater depth. Manager's Pro-Tip: Bake a 'material vs non-material matrix' into your internal compliance SOP — every proposed PPM amendment should be triaged through the matrix before it reaches the merchant banker to avoid accidentally triggering a costly 30-day investor exit window.
